Hermes Agent v0.22.7

BaoYi embeds the unmodified Hermes Agent runtime at commit b200f5bc60e31588ba2cb60e288029c4a54ba5fa.
Source archive SHA-256: 10880f6df64275dddf50d6319aed16eb0ba6a79542a064e3dbbc00df88855a91.
The embedded runtime is used as a local library through its AIAgent API; BaoYi supplies a JSONL host and archive tools.
Python-build-standalone and uv asset hashes, plus the frozen dependency export, are recorded in resources/hermes-runtime/manifest.json and requirements.txt in the packaged app (output/hermes-runtime in a development checkout).
The dependency inventory and shipped license file paths are in dependencies.json. Python's license is at python/LICENSE.txt; each dependency retains its installed license notices in python/Lib/site-packages. uv is a build tool and is not shipped in the app.
